reader_can_describe.answer: One decaying activation per modeled neuron, fixed weights/bias/transfer/time constant; current activations determine inputs/rates; a rate-pattern peak represents an angle.

reader_can_describe.question: How do neurons depend on each other?
reader_can_describe.sites: 80-104 earlier weight direction and one-event feedback,254 conditional independence,272 inhibitory ring,274 simulation consequence
reader_can_describe.answer: One spike changes its outgoing activation; weights change receiving inputs; transfer function changes later spike probabilities. Elementary draws are independent only conditional on current state.
